eclipse-phase.power.optogenetics-module.name: Optogenetics Module

effect.summary: A controller triggers one selected neural effect: unconsciousness, behavior change, sensory alteration, or pleasure.

eclipse-phase.power.optogenetics-module.cost_or_limit: One selected function per module; multiple modules may be installed. Knockout can be resisted with a WIL Check at −30; success grants one-hour immunity to that function.
eclipse-phase.power.optogenetics-module.mind: May compel or restrict behavior, interrupt senses, cause unconsciousness, or trigger pleasure.
eclipse-phase.power.optogenetics-module.who_may: Biomorphs genetically modified to have light-sensitive neurons; a monitor ALI or meshed overseer commonly controls it.
eclipse-phase.power.optogenetics-module.combines: Installation includes the required genetic modification; sensory effects follow a mindware hacking technique.
eclipse-phase.power.optogenetics-module.blocked_reason: The module can impose behavior and sensory effects on a target's mind.

eclipse-phase.power.possum-cache.name: Possum Cache

effect.summary: Keeps cyberbrain and mental augmentations running after a morph dies or hibernates.

eclipse-phase.power.possum-cache.cost_or_limit: Requires a cyberbrain, ghostrider module, or mesh inserts; backup power lasts two weeks, adjustable for usage, or indefinitely with external power. No benefit while merely unconscious or incapacitated; head destruction can disable it.
eclipse-phase.power.possum-cache.go_wrong: Active users without sensory input or mesh links may face weekly stress checks; more than 10 DV to the head after death can destroy the cyberbrain.
eclipse-phase.power.possum-cache.mind: The ego remains active but has no access to morph sensory input; sensory deprivation may cause stress.
eclipse-phase.power.possum-cache.who_may: An ego in a morph with a cyberbrain, ghostrider module, or mesh inserts.
eclipse-phase.power.possum-cache.combines: Can run indefinitely on external power through access jacks.
eclipse-phase.power.possum-cache.blocked_reason: It specifies ego activity after death and conditions under which the ego remains operational.

eclipse-phase.power.stabilizer.name: Stabilizer

effect.summary: Automatically heals one point of stress each day.

eclipse-phase.power.stabilizer.cost_or_limit: No bonus on a day when another stress-reducing effect or psychosurgery applies; does not affect trauma or disorders.
eclipse-phase.power.stabilizer.mind: Monitors and adjusts the user's digital mental state.
eclipse-phase.power.stabilizer.combines: Does not stack on days with other stress reduction.
eclipse-phase.power.stabilizer.blocked_reason: Stress removal is a basic mind effect.

eclipse-phase.power.brachiating-adaptati.name: Brachiating Adaptation

effect.summary: Enables swinging between objects and longer swing jumps while providing extended reach.

eclipse-phase.power.brachiating-adaptati.cost_or_limit: In Earth or Venus gravity, only small morphs brachiate, using both arms at 8/32 Movement Rate; jump up to 4 meters or 12 with a full move. In low or microgravity, medium and large morphs can brachiate at 4/20; jumping is normal.
eclipse-phase.power.brachiating-adaptati.who_may: Morphs with the adaptation; size eligibility depends on gravity.
eclipse-phase.power.brachiating-adaptati.combines: Use Athletics; lengthened arms give +10 Reach, potentially offset by the reach of larger morphs.
eclipse-phase.power.brachiating-adaptati.blocked_reason: Movement and reach enhancements are basic effects.

eclipse-phase.power.convertible-form.name: Convertible Form

effect.summary: Switches the morph among preset body configurations in three action turns.

eclipse-phase.power.convertible-form.cost_or_limit: May be taken repeatedly for more configurations; with shape adjusting ware, configurations can contain one Moderate or two Minor items/ware, but rapid reassembly may fail outside the default form.
eclipse-phase.power.convertible-form.go_wrong: Rapid reassembly from a non-default configuration may not be possible.
eclipse-phase.power.convertible-form.combines: With shape adjusting ware, enables specified preset equipment configurations.
eclipse-phase.power.convertible-form.blocked_reason: The ware changes the morph's body plan between configurations.

eclipse-phase.power.digestive-symbiotes.name: Digestive Symbiotes

effect.summary: Allows digestion of most organic matter and protection from orally delivered biochem toxins.

eclipse-phase.power.digestive-symbiotes.cost_or_limit: A successful SOM Check negates an oral-vector biochem toxin; otherwise +30 against its effects and its duration and effects are halved. No protection from other vectors or nanotoxins.
eclipse-phase.power.digestive-symbiotes.go_wrong: Some substances may require a WIL Check to eat.
eclipse-phase.power.digestive-symbiotes.mind: Can mute taste; may make certain substances difficult to eat.
eclipse-phase.power.digestive-symbiotes.combines: Can digest some otherwise inedible xenoflora and xenofauna.
eclipse-phase.power.digestive-symbiotes.blocked_reason: Digestion and toxin protection can be represented as basic self-targeted effects.

eclipse-phase.power.digging-claws.name: Digging Claws

effect.summary: Sturdy claws loosen ground, tear hard surfaces, and inflict melee damage.

eclipse-phase.power.digging-claws.combines: Unlike normal claw ware, the claws are not concealable.
eclipse-phase.power.digging-claws.blocked_reason: Melee force and tool use are basic effects.

eclipse-phase.power.efficient-metabolism.name: Efficient Metabolism

effect.summary: Reduces food and water needs and extends survival without supplies.

eclipse-phase.power.efficient-metabolism.cost_or_limit: Needs food and drink only weekly; can survive a month without water and two months without food, though starvation effects begin after about two weeks. Incompatible with long-term life support and energy efficiency ware.
eclipse-phase.power.efficient-metabolism.go_wrong: Starvation and dehydration effects begin after roughly two weeks without supplies.
eclipse-phase.power.efficient-metabolism.combines: Incompatible with long-term life support and energy efficiency ware.
eclipse-phase.power.efficient-metabolism.blocked_reason: The ware changes bodily resource needs, expressible as a self-targeted effect.

eclipse-phase.power.extra-limbs.name: Extra Limbs

effect.summary: Adds a pair of usable, articulated and/or prehensile manipulating limbs.

eclipse-phase.power.extra-limbs.cost_or_limit: Only mechanically useful manipulative limbs count; availability or complexity is GM-dependent.
eclipse-phase.power.extra-limbs.go_wrong: May be impossible or more complex for some morphs.
eclipse-phase.power.extra-limbs.who_may: A morph that can support the additional limbs.
eclipse-phase.power.extra-limbs.combines: May be transgenic, including insectoid or tentacular variants.
eclipse-phase.power.extra-limbs.blocked_reason: The ware adds limbs as physical capabilities.

eclipse-phase.power.gliding-membrane.name: Gliding Membrane

effect.summary: Allows controlled gliding and riding thermal updrafts.

eclipse-phase.power.gliding-membrane.cost_or_limit: Movement Rate 8/32; human-sized morphs glide 10 meters per meter of altitude lost at 1 g and 20 or more in low gravity; +10 to relevant Free Fall Tests. Requires all four limbs to maintain glide and compatible clothing.
eclipse-phase.power.gliding-membrane.combines: Use Athletics for movement; requires smart or customized clothing.

eclipse-phase.power.heat-tolerance.name: Heat Tolerance

effect.summary: Prevents discomfort or ill effects at high temperatures.

eclipse-phase.power.heat-tolerance.cost_or_limit: Tolerance up to 130°F/54°C for biomorphs or 500°F/260°C for synthmorphs.
eclipse-phase.power.heat-tolerance.blocked_reason: Heat protection is a basic effect.

eclipse-phase.power.high-g-adaptation.name: High-G Adaptation

effect.summary: Reduces penalties from high gravity.

eclipse-phase.power.high-g-adaptation.cost_or_limit: Requires hardened skeleton ware; ignores penalties up to 2 g, then treats gravity as 1 g lower.

eclipse-phase.power.long-term-life-suppo.name: Long-Term Life Support

effect.summary: Lets a biomorph survive extended periods without ordinary air, food, or water.

eclipse-phase.power.long-term-life-suppo.cost_or_limit: Can last up to a month on minimal organic matter; chemical reserve packs extend operation to a year, after which the system needs servicing. Supplements support long-term health; incompatible with efficient metabolism.
eclipse-phase.power.long-term-life-suppo.go_wrong: The system must be flushed, balanced, and replenished after up to a year.
eclipse-phase.power.long-term-life-suppo.combines: Incompatible with efficient metabolism; uses reserve packs for extended operation.
eclipse-phase.power.long-term-life-suppo.blocked_reason: The ware extends survival by changing resource requirements.

eclipse-phase.power.magnetic-generator.name: Magnetic Generator

effect.summary: Creates a protective magnetic field and enables movement by tacking against magnetic fields or sailing on solar wind.

eclipse-phase.power.magnetic-generator.cost_or_limit: Only for very large morphs; AV +15/+0; space Movement Rate 8/40 and Pilot: Space.
eclipse-phase.power.magnetic-generator.combines: Can be used near the sun and certain planets, or with the solar wind.
eclipse-phase.power.magnetic-generator.blocked_reason: Protection and movement can be represented with force-blocking and movement effects.

eclipse-phase.power.oozeware.name: Oozeware

effect.summary: A gel-like morph changes parts or all of its body into basic forms, limbs, or simple tools.

eclipse-phase.power.oozeware.cost_or_limit: Can form two Moderate items, four Minor items, or one Moderate plus two Minor; transformation takes 1d6 Action Turns. Synthmorphs gain AV 4/0 and half damage from kinetic projectiles; no frame. Incompatible with synthetic mask and shape adjusting ware.
eclipse-phase.power.oozeware.combines: Can form listed ware and mobility systems; incompatible with synthetic mask and shape adjusting ware.
eclipse-phase.power.oozeware.blocked_reason: It transforms the body's form into multiple tools and equipment configurations.

eclipse-phase.power.radiation-tolerance.name: Radiation Tolerance

effect.summary: Protects the morph from damaging ionizing radiation and particles.

eclipse-phase.power.radiation-tolerance.cost_or_limit: Limited against extreme sources and prolonged exposure; biomorph version requires medichines.
eclipse-phase.power.radiation-tolerance.go_wrong: Protection can fail against extreme or prolonged radiation.
eclipse-phase.power.radiation-tolerance.blocked_reason: Radiation protection is a basic self-targeted blocking effect.

eclipse-phase.power.refractive-coating.name: Refractive Coating

effect.summary: Reflects or mitigates most visual and infrared wavelengths and aids radiative cooling.

eclipse-phase.power.refractive-coating.who_may: A morph with the coating; particularly useful to coronal morphs.
eclipse-phase.power.refractive-coating.combines: Uses reflectors, absorbers, and spectral filters.
eclipse-phase.power.refractive-coating.blocked_reason: The stated protection is a basic blocking effect.

eclipse-phase.power.swarm-shape.name: Swarm Shape

effect.summary: Linked swarm drones form a small body with limbs capable of limited activity and tool use.

eclipse-phase.power.swarm-shape.cost_or_limit: Standard swarm forms a one-meter body with up to four half-meter limbs; handles Very Small or smaller gear, suffers −30 with Small gear, and cannot affect Medium or larger objects. Leverage, strength, and fine dexterity are impaired or unavailable.
eclipse-phase.power.swarm-shape.combines: Drones link together to form the body.
eclipse-phase.power.swarm-shape.blocked_reason: The swarm's component drones assemble into a larger articulated body.

eclipse-phase.power.swim-bladder.name: Swim Bladder

effect.summary: Controls buoyancy for hovering at depth and ascending or descending.

eclipse-phase.power.swim-bladder.cost_or_limit: Works underwater or in thick atmospheres; linked sensors gauge pressure and depth.
eclipse-phase.power.swim-bladder.combines: Linked to inner-ear or internal sensors.
eclipse-phase.power.swim-bladder.blocked_reason: Buoyancy and movement can be represented as position effects.

eclipse-phase.power.aggressive-grm.name: Aggressive GRM

effect.summary: Prevents reproduction and rejects unauthorized modifications unless unlocked.

eclipse-phase.power.aggressive-grm.cost_or_limit: Biomorph only; unlocking requires genehacking expertise or a Medicine: Biotech Test at −30.
eclipse-phase.power.aggressive-grm.go_wrong: Unauthorized installed mods cause wound effects until removed.
eclipse-phase.power.aggressive-grm.combines: Restricts bioware, cyberware, and nanoware not in the original design.
eclipse-phase.power.aggressive-grm.blocked_reason: The trait restricts reproduction and installation of modifications.

eclipse-phase.power.emotive.name: Emotive

effect.summary: Makes the synthmorph's emotional range unusually expressive, removing the usual Kinesics penalty.

eclipse-phase.power.emotive.combines: Kinesics tests against the user avoid the usual −30 modifier.
eclipse-phase.power.emotive.blocked_reason: The trait changes observable emotional display.

eclipse-phase.power.fast-metabolism.name: Fast Metabolism

effect.summary: Raises food requirements and causes declining durability and wound threshold when underfed.

eclipse-phase.power.fast-metabolism.cost_or_limit: Biomorphs only; requires two to three times normal food and is a Minor-complexity daily need in scarcity.
eclipse-phase.power.fast-metabolism.go_wrong: After two days without enough food, Wound Threshold falls by 1 and Durability by 5, with equivalent reductions every further two days; at Durability 5, death is imminent without extended care.
eclipse-phase.power.fast-metabolism.combines: Food scarcity makes the trait especially problematic in remote places.
eclipse-phase.power.fast-metabolism.blocked_reason: The trait changes food needs and bodily durability.

eclipse-phase.power.grav-sickness.name: Grav Sickness

effect.summary: Imposes high-gravity wound effects above the morph's low-gravity adaptation.

eclipse-phase.power.grav-sickness.cost_or_limit: Biomorphs adapted to gravity at or below 0.15 g; suffers one wound effect for every 0.2 g above that.
eclipse-phase.power.grav-sickness.go_wrong: Higher gravity increases wound effects; Earth or Venus gravity causes four.

eclipse-phase.power.impaired-balance.name: Impaired Balance

effect.summary: Penalizes balance- and upright-movement-related Athletics or Pilot Tests.

eclipse-phase.power.impaired-balance.cost_or_limit: −10 per level; commonly applies to neo-pigs and other non-biped-derived morphs.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-balance.who_may: Neo-pigs and other morphs derived from non-bipeds.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-balance.combines: Affects Athletics or Pilot tests involving balance or upright movement.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-balance.blocked_reason: The trait applies a skill penalty.

eclipse-phase.power.impaired-hearing.name: Impaired Hearing

effect.summary: Restricts hearing to a narrow frequency band and penalizes hearing-based perception.

eclipse-phase.power.impaired-hearing.cost_or_limit: Only hears 400–1,000 kHz; poor hearing outside water and −30 to hearing-based Perceive Tests; some sounds may be inaudible.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-hearing.who_may: Neo-octopi and similar species-derived morphs lacking transgenic hearing.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-hearing.blocked_reason: The trait blocks or limits sensory input.

eclipse-phase.power.impaired-propriocept.name: Impaired Proprioception

effect.summary: The morph cannot sense limb positions without looking and suffers a Fray penalty.

eclipse-phase.power.impaired-propriocept.cost_or_limit: −10 to Fray Tests; limbs may get caught, grab objects, or interfere with activity.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-propriocept.go_wrong: May cause additional narrative consequences on superior or critical failures.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-propriocept.mind: The user's sense of body position and movement is impaired.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-propriocept.who_may: Flying squid, neo-octopi, and similar derived morphs.
eclipse-phase.power.impaired-propriocept.blocked_reason: The trait changes proprioceptive sensing and applies a penalty.

eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-manipulators.name: Lack of Manipulators

effect.summary: Limits or prevents handling objects because the morph lacks fine manipulatory limbs.

eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-manipulators.cost_or_limit: Some items impose −30 or cannot be used; wireless-controlled tools work normally. Holding and moving objects together may be impossible, and upright handling may require a REF Check.
eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-manipulators.who_may: Morphs without hands or other fine manipulators, including quadrupeds and some smart animals.
eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-manipulators.combines: Equipment designed for the morph may reduce the limitation.
eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-manipulators.blocked_reason: The trait restricts which objects the morph can physically manipulate.

eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-smell.name: Lack of Smell

effect.summary: Removes smell and weakens taste, while preventing effects from enhanced pheromones.

eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-smell.cost_or_limit: Cannot make smell-based Perceive Tests; many foods taste alike.
eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-smell.go_wrong: The morph misses cooking, perfume, rot, smoke, and chemical odorants.
eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-smell.who_may: Morphs lacking functional olfactory organs or abilities.
eclipse-phase.power.lack-of-smell.blocked_reason: The trait blocks a sensory channel.

eclipse-phase.power.neurochemical-imbala.name: Neurochemical Imbalance

effect.summary: Randomly imposes one of six Level 2 emotional or behavioral traits.

eclipse-phase.power.neurochemical-imbala.cost_or_limit: Triggered whenever the user spends a pool point or makes a WIL Check; effect lasts 1d6 hours.
eclipse-phase.power.neurochemical-imbala.go_wrong: Strong mood swings and overwhelming emotions; the GM selects from six behaviors.
eclipse-phase.power.neurochemical-imbala.combines: Drugs, psychosurgery, or certain ware can reduce or block effects but cannot simultaneously trigger other emotions.
eclipse-phase.power.neurochemical-imbala.blocked_reason: It imposes behavioral changes on the user's mind.

eclipse-phase.power.personality-artifact.name: Personality Artifact

effect.summary: Activates a lingering former-ego personality trait or motivation that changes the current ego's personality.

eclipse-phase.power.personality-artifact.cost_or_limit: Once per session, randomly select one of six traits; lasts 1d6 days and causes a Willpower Stress Test against SV 1d6 or higher.
eclipse-phase.power.personality-artifact.go_wrong: The alteration can be strong or contrary to the user's usual personality; psychosurgery only removes it temporarily.
eclipse-phase.power.personality-artifact.mind: Changes the ego's disposition in a way that feels natural to the affected ego.
eclipse-phase.power.personality-artifact.who_may: A morph that has hosted prior egos.
eclipse-phase.power.personality-artifact.combines: Psychosurgery can suppress it temporarily but cannot erase it completely.
eclipse-phase.power.personality-artifact.blocked_reason: It imposes a lasting personality change on the ego.

eclipse-phase.power.whole-body-apoptosis.name: Whole Body Apoptosis

effect.summary: Genetically programmed cellular failure kills the biomorph at a future time.

eclipse-phase.power.whole-body-apoptosis.cost_or_limit: Usually set within a ten-year period; a chosen date can be targeted within a few months; failure takes about ten minutes.
eclipse-phase.power.whole-body-apoptosis.go_wrong: A critical failure may be converted to a regular failure and trigger death within 24 hours, if the player agrees to that condition.
eclipse-phase.power.whole-body-apoptosis.combines: The GM can connect its trigger to a critical failure.
eclipse-phase.power.whole-body-apoptosis.blocked_reason: The trait schedules a lethal death event and defines its timing.

eclipse-phase.power.adversarial-hacker.name: Adversarial Hacker

effect.summary: Spends Insight to flip-flop a GM-controlled system defender's roll.

eclipse-phase.power.adversarial-hacker.cost_or_limit: Costs one Insight; unavailable if the character already modified their own test with pool points. GM Threat expenditure cancels the effect.
eclipse-phase.power.adversarial-hacker.combines: Interacts with Insight and Threat pools.
eclipse-phase.power.adversarial-hacker.blocked_reason: This is a roll alteration and can be handled as a basic luck effect.

eclipse-phase.power.agi-affinity.name: AGI Affinity

effect.summary: Improves social skills when interacting with AGIs.

eclipse-phase.power.agi-affinity.cost_or_limit: +10 to social skills in those interactions.
eclipse-phase.power.agi-affinity.mind: Provides intuitive understanding of AGI mannerisms and quirks.
eclipse-phase.power.agi-affinity.combines: Applies only when interacting with AGIs.
eclipse-phase.power.agi-affinity.blocked_reason: A skill bonus is a basic effect.

eclipse-phase.power.async-familiarity.name: Async Familiarity

effect.summary: Identifies an async from behavioral clues after observation and a successful test.

eclipse-phase.power.async-familiarity.cost_or_limit: Requires at least an hour observing, then a Kinesics Test at −30 opposed by Deceive.
eclipse-phase.power.async-familiarity.who_may: Most commonly asyncs, but also characters who studied them or spent substantial time with them.
eclipse-phase.power.async-familiarity.combines: GM may allow identifying secret exsurgents with the Psi trait.
eclipse-phase.power.async-familiarity.blocked_reason: The trait senses information from observable behavior.

eclipse-phase.power.brain-worm.name: Brain Worm

effect.summary: Conceals an async's sleight from targets unless the Psi Test is a superior failure.

eclipse-phase.power.brain-worm.cost_or_limit: Only available to asyncs; target awareness normally applies, but the target notices only on a superior-failure Psi Test.
eclipse-phase.power.brain-worm.mind: Sleights subtly insinuate themselves into targets' minds.
eclipse-phase.power.brain-worm.blocked_reason: The trait alters awareness of psychic targeting and implies an effect on a target's mind.

eclipse-phase.power.controlled-infection.name: Controlled Infection

effect.summary: Chooses an infection influence effect rather than rolling randomly.

eclipse-phase.power.controlled-infection.cost_or_limit: Async only; spends one Moxie when an Infection Test succeeds.
eclipse-phase.power.controlled-infection.mind: Provides some control over the infection's influence.
eclipse-phase.power.controlled-infection.combines: Modifies the outcome of an Infection Test.
eclipse-phase.power.controlled-infection.blocked_reason: The trait changes a random outcome into a chosen one.

eclipse-phase.power.danger-instinct.name: Danger Instinct

effect.summary: Raises Initiative but may give the GM control of the character's response to sudden danger.

eclipse-phase.power.danger-instinct.cost_or_limit: Uplifts only; +2 Initiative; a WIL Check is required when surprised or faced with a sudden threat.
eclipse-phase.power.danger-instinct.go_wrong: On a failed check, the GM determines the response, usually fleeing, hiding, or attacking.
eclipse-phase.power.danger-instinct.mind: Triggers species-based threat responses before conscious thought.
eclipse-phase.power.danger-instinct.blocked_reason: On failure, the trait dictates the character's action.

eclipse-phase.power.data-control.name: Data Control

effect.summary: Apply a −10 modifier per level to online tests tracking or finding information about you.

eclipse-phase.power.data-control.blocked_reason: The stated effect fits the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.power.digital-ghost.name: Digital Ghost

effect.summary: Spends Insight to automatically stop a defender from locating an intruder.

eclipse-phase.power.digital-ghost.cost_or_limit: Costs one Insight; applies to attempts to zero in on the user as an intruder.
eclipse-phase.power.digital-ghost.who_may: A character with the trait while intruding into a system.
eclipse-phase.power.digital-ghost.combines: Applies to Zeroing In and Locate Intruder attempts.

eclipse-phase.power.drone-whisperer.name: Drone Whisperer

effect.summary: Once per session, use Flex on a test by an autonomous drone following your orders.

eclipse-phase.power.drone-whisperer.cost_or_limit: Once per session; drone must follow your orders
eclipse-phase.power.drone-whisperer.mechanism: pool use on another actor's test
eclipse-phase.power.drone-whisperer.blocked_reason: The stated effect fits the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.power.edge-runner.name: Edge Runner

effect.summary: Avoids the usual hacking penalty when a system is on active alert.

eclipse-phase.power.edge-runner.cost_or_limit: Applies while hacking an alerted system.

eclipse-phase.power.exceptional-muse.name: Exceptional Muse

effect.summary: Gives the character's muse one Insight or Flex pool point usable only for its own actions.

eclipse-phase.power.exceptional-muse.cost_or_limit: Choose one pool; normal pool rules apply.
eclipse-phase.power.exceptional-muse.who_may: A character whose muse has the trait.
eclipse-phase.power.exceptional-muse.combines: Pool point is restricted to actions and tests made by the muse.
eclipse-phase.power.exceptional-muse.blocked_reason: The trait adds a restricted pool point.

eclipse-phase.power.gold-star.name: Gold Star

effect.summary: Improves Rep and social skill tests with one faction that respects the character.

eclipse-phase.power.gold-star.cost_or_limit: +10 per level; incompatible with Blocklisted Rep or Black Mark for the same faction.
eclipse-phase.power.gold-star.who_may: A character who earned the respect of a particular faction.
eclipse-phase.power.gold-star.combines: Uses the faction list, with criminal and hypercorp factions optionally divided into smaller groups.
eclipse-phase.power.gold-star.blocked_reason: The trait provides a contextual skill bonus.

eclipse-phase.power.dual-strains.name: Dual Strains

effect.summary: Have two infections but use one strain's traits, sleights, and influence at a time; switch when an Infection Test fails.

eclipse-phase.power.dual-strains.cost_or_limit: Restricted to asyncs; one strain active at a time
eclipse-phase.power.dual-strains.go_wrong: Infection Test failure triggers a switch
eclipse-phase.power.dual-strains.blocked_reason: It coordinates multiple power sets and changes which one is active.

eclipse-phase.power.habitat-tranquility.name: Habitat Tranquility

effect.summary: In one chosen habitat, gain +10 to INT checks for healing stress and halve recovery time for stress, trauma, and disorders.

eclipse-phase.power.habitat-tranquility.cost_or_limit: One specific habitat; recovery-time benefit does not stack with Resilient Mind
eclipse-phase.power.habitat-tranquility.combines: Does not stack with Resilient Mind's recovery time
eclipse-phase.power.habitat-tranquility.blocked_reason: The effect is restricted to a particular habitat.

eclipse-phase.power.hard-knocks.name: Hard Knocks

effect.summary: Regain one spent pool point after a critical failure on a test without pool expenditure.

eclipse-phase.power.hard-knocks.cost_or_limit: Maximum three points between long recharges
eclipse-phase.power.hard-knocks.go_wrong: Only triggers on critical failure and no pool spent
eclipse-phase.power.hard-knocks.blocked_reason: The stated effect is a conditional resource increase.

eclipse-phase.power.home-turf.name: Home Turf

effect.summary: Gain one ego Flex usable only for tests or narrative actions involving a chosen habitat.

eclipse-phase.power.home-turf.blocked_reason: Its resource is limited to a named local area.

eclipse-phase.power.improved-beta.name: Improved Beta

effect.summary: Choose one improvement to beta forks from four listed benefits.

eclipse-phase.power.improved-beta.cost_or_limit: May be taken repeatedly for separate benefits
eclipse-phase.power.improved-beta.go_wrong: Psi-retaining benefit removes half the sleights
eclipse-phase.power.improved-beta.mind: Changes beta-fork limitations and retained psi features
eclipse-phase.power.improved-beta.combines: Beta forks; Psi trait and sleights
eclipse-phase.power.improved-beta.blocked_reason: It modifies the properties and abilities of copied egos.

eclipse-phase.power.intrusion-speed.name: Intrusion Speed

effect.summary: Halve the timeframe for subtle intrusions.

eclipse-phase.power.intrusion-speed.combines: Superior successes may further reduce time
eclipse-phase.power.intrusion-speed.blocked_reason: The stated effect fits the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.power.manipulative-streak.name: Manipulative Streak

effect.summary: Spend Moxie to flip an NPC's roll against your Deceive, Persuade, or Provoke test.

eclipse-phase.power.manipulative-streak.cost_or_limit: Cannot use if you modified your own test with pool; GM Threat cancels expenditure
eclipse-phase.power.manipulative-streak.blocked_reason: The stated effect fits the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.power.meme-fame.name: Meme Fame

effect.summary: Gain +10 to social and Rep tests on first meeting an NPC who recognizes your meme.

eclipse-phase.power.meme-fame.cost_or_limit: Only first interaction with a recognizing NPC
eclipse-phase.power.meme-fame.blocked_reason: The stated effect fits the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.power.merging-mastery.name: Merging Mastery

effect.summary: Prevent memory loss when merging forks, except a critical failure causes minor loss.

eclipse-phase.power.merging-mastery.cost_or_limit: Critical failure still causes minor memory loss
eclipse-phase.power.merging-mastery.go_wrong: Critical failure causes minor memory loss
eclipse-phase.power.merging-mastery.blocked_reason: The effect concerns memories and reintegration of forked egos.

eclipse-phase.power.mind-flayer.name: Mind Flayer

effect.summary: Ignore the −30 modifier for mindware hacking.

eclipse-phase.power.mind-flayer.blocked_reason: The stated effect fits the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.power.minion-partner.name: Minion/Partner

eclipse-phase.rule.mind-copying-and-down.blocked_reason: Creating and transferring persistent mind copies requires modeling separate ego instances.

eclipse-phase.rule.forks.name: Forks

effect.summary: Without backup insurance, retrieval and re-instantiation after death depend on circumstances and may fail permanently.

eclipse-phase.rule.backup-recovery-witho.cost_or_limit: Return may be delayed or come with significantly fewer MP; permanent death is possible.
eclipse-phase.rule.backup-recovery-witho.mind: An ego's re-instantiation depends on circumstances.
eclipse-phase.rule.backup-recovery-witho.combines: May result in lower MP or permanent death.
eclipse-phase.rule.backup-recovery-witho.blocked_reason: Death, ego recovery, and possible permanent non-return require soul-state rules.

eclipse-phase.rule.planned-maintenance-d.name: Planned maintenance decay

effect.summary: Skipping monthly maintenance causes pool loss, then unrecoverable wounds and incapacitation.

eclipse-phase.rule.planned-maintenance-d.cost_or_limit: Moderate service required monthly; four accumulated wounds incapacitate.
eclipse-phase.rule.planned-maintenance-d.go_wrong: Pools fall by one each missed month; once they reach zero, a wound accrues monthly and cannot be repaired or healed.
eclipse-phase.rule.planned-maintenance-d.combines: A licensed provider or black-market pirate can restore full function through service.
eclipse-phase.rule.planned-maintenance-d.blocked_reason: The rule requires cumulative degradation and a threshold that changes the consequences over time.

eclipse-phase.rule.allergy-exposure-and-.name: Allergy exposure and treatment window

effect.summary: Exposure to a severe allergen can cause anaphylactic shock and death unless treated within a limited period.

eclipse-phase.rule.allergy-exposure-and-.cost_or_limit: Death from respiratory failure in 2d10 minutes without successful paramedic treatment.
eclipse-phase.rule.allergy-exposure-and-.go_wrong: Incisive exposure can lead to incapacitation and death.
eclipse-phase.rule.allergy-exposure-and-.combines: A successful Medicine: Paramedic test provides treatment.
eclipse-phase.rule.allergy-exposure-and-.blocked_reason: The hazard escalates over a time limit and may become fatal.

eclipse-phase.rule.character-skill-maxim.name: Character skill maximum

effect.summary: A character’s skill value cannot exceed 80 in the example’s creation process.

eclipse-phase.rule.character-skill-maxim.where_from: Character creation rules described in the example.
eclipse-phase.rule.character-skill-maxim.combines: Overflow points can be spent on other skills.
eclipse-phase.rule.character-skill-maxim.blocked_reason: This is a direct numeric limit.

eclipse-phase.rule.async-infection-ratin.name: Async infection rating

effect.summary: Infection Rating is calculated as Psi trait level multiplied by ten.

eclipse-phase.rule.async-infection-ratin.who_may: Async characters with a Psi trait.
eclipse-phase.rule.async-infection-ratin.combines: The example’s level-2 Psi trait produces a rating of 20.
eclipse-phase.rule.async-infection-ratin.blocked_reason: A simple numerical calculation is sufficient.

eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.name: Ego restoration from backup

effect.summary: A dead character can be restored from a backup made before death, with memories only up to that backup.

eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.cost_or_limit: The restored state reflects the backup’s date.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.go_wrong: Later memories and experiences are absent.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.mind: Restoration can leave gaps in personal memory.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.who_may: A character whose ego was backed up.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.where_from: The character’s account of dying during the Fall.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.combines: The character returned with a backup made weeks earlier.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-restoration-from-.blocked_reason: Restoration from a prior mind-state and its continuity effects require backup and soul-state rules.

eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.name: Ego stack theft and virtual slavery

effect.summary: An ego stack can be uploaded into virtual slave pits and traded by criminal operators.

eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.cost_or_limit: The rescue offer requires a price, but no terms are stated.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.go_wrong: A character can be enslaved through an uploaded stack.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.mind: The captive ego is subject to virtual enslavement.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.who_may: Operators who control or trade ego stacks.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.where_from: The character’s involvement with Nine Lives.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.combines: Associated with Nine Lives and its Petra Nanchon arm.
eclipse-phase.rule.ego-stack-theft-and-v.blocked_reason: The passage describes captivity and trade of an uploaded ego, which requires modeling ego-state and custody.

eclipse-phase.rule.mind-backups-and-copi.name: Mind backups and copies

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.mind-backups-and-copi.cost_or_limit: Copies raise issues of ownership and identity.
eclipse-phase.rule.mind-backups-and-copi.mind: Copies can complicate identity and culpability.
eclipse-phase.rule.mind-backups-and-copi.combines: Forks and time-contracted simulspace are mentioned.
eclipse-phase.rule.mind-backups-and-copi.mechanism: Mind backup, copying, and fork identity.
eclipse-phase.rule.mind-backups-and-copi.blocked_reason: The passage describes mind-copy consequences that require soul-state rules.

eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-labor-cont.name: Indentured labor contracts

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-labor-cont.cost_or_limit: Workers serve for a contracted period; one example is ten years.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-labor-cont.go_wrong: Contracts can be traded as commodities.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-labor-cont.who_may: Workers and contract-holding investors or hypercorps.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-labor-cont.where_from: Space expansion and post-Fall labor recruitment.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-labor-cont.combines: Formalized through IndEx after the Fall.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-labor-cont.blocked_reason: The rule depends on transferable contracts and obligations.

eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-operatio.name: Pandora Gate operation

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-operatio.cost_or_limit: The gates link to corresponding gates, but their operation and builders are unknown.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-operatio.blocked_reason: The rule requires a defined spatial transit mechanism.

eclipse-phase.rule.earth-cordon.name: Earth cordon

effect.summary: A flotilla of kill-satellites prevents ships from traveling to or from Earth.

eclipse-phase.rule.earth-cordon.cost_or_limit: Travel in either direction is blocked.
eclipse-phase.rule.earth-cordon.blocked_reason: The rule requires a persistent spatial exclusion barrier enforced by satellites.

eclipse-phase.rule.cortical-stack-recove.name: Cortical stack recovery

effect.summary: Stacks may be recovered after death, except from corpses showing exsurgent transformation.

eclipse-phase.rule.cortical-stack-recove.cost_or_limit: 50% recovery chance per character, falling to 5% if the body is hard to find
eclipse-phase.rule.cortical-stack-recove.go_wrong: A transformed corpse's stack is not taken
eclipse-phase.rule.cortical-stack-recove.blocked_reason: Stack recovery and re-instantiation depend on persistent identity and backup state.

eclipse-phase.rule.continuity.name: Continuity

effect.summary: Restoring a backup brings back the ego as it was when saved, not the intervening experiences.

eclipse-phase.rule.continuity.cost_or_limit: Frequent backups and experience recordings can reduce missing time.
eclipse-phase.rule.continuity.go_wrong: Missing experiences can cause existential discomfort.
eclipse-phase.rule.continuity.mind: The restored person lacks memories since the backup.
eclipse-phase.rule.continuity.combines: Experience playback can help catch the restored ego up.
eclipse-phase.rule.continuity.blocked_reason: The distinction between a continuing consciousness and a restored copy needs soul-state mechanics.

eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-co.name: Indentured service contracts

effect.summary: Infugees work for earnings toward a morph and habitat access, but charges may extend their contracts.

eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-co.cost_or_limit: Hidden expense charges can prolong service.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-co.combines: Contracts are traded and registered through IndEx.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-co.blocked_reason: The described economic rule does not require an effect outside the basic grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.fork-duration-limits.name: Fork duration limits

effect.summary: Many jurisdictions require a fork to be reintegrated or deleted within a day.

eclipse-phase.rule.fork-duration-limits.cost_or_limit: Local laws vary; some ban forks or treat them as property.
eclipse-phase.rule.fork-duration-limits.go_wrong: Legal disputes can arise over responsibility and rights.
eclipse-phase.rule.fork-duration-limits.mind: Forks may have independent experiences before reintegration.
eclipse-phase.rule.fork-duration-limits.where_from: Social and legal responses to multiplicity.
eclipse-phase.rule.fork-duration-limits.blocked_reason: Managing multiple simultaneous egos and their reintegration requires soul-state mechanics.

eclipse-phase.rule.time-dilated-vr.name: Time-dilated VR

effect.summary: Virtual time can pass faster than real time, allowing long experiences in a short interval.

eclipse-phase.rule.time-dilated-vr.mind: Users experience the accelerated virtual duration.
eclipse-phase.rule.time-dilated-vr.combines: Used for virtual work, leisure, and deep-space travel.
eclipse-phase.rule.time-dilated-vr.blocked_reason: Changing the rate of experienced time is not covered by the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.newton-s-most-famous-.name: Newton’s most famous Law

effect.summary: An action produces an equal and opposite reaction.

eclipse-phase.rule.newton-s-most-famous-.cost_or_limit: Applies to movement in microgravity as described.
eclipse-phase.rule.newton-s-most-famous-.where_from: The passage describes it as Newton’s law.
eclipse-phase.rule.newton-s-most-famous-.blocked_reason: This is a physical-world mechanism, not a character effect.

eclipse-phase.rule.slow-transition-betwe.name: Slow transition between gravity zones

effect.summary: Changing gravity gradually helps prevent motion sickness and accidents.

eclipse-phase.rule.slow-transition-betwe.cost_or_limit: Rapid transition raises risk of sickness or accidents.
eclipse-phase.rule.slow-transition-betwe.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward environmental restriction.

eclipse-phase.rule.hygiene-routines-alwa.name: Hygiene routines always avoid free-floating water

effect.summary: Free-floating water is avoided because it can damage electronics.

eclipse-phase.rule.hygiene-routines-alwa.cost_or_limit: Water is used only when absolutely necessary.
eclipse-phase.rule.hygiene-routines-alwa.blocked_reason: The rule describes a simple hazard and restriction.

eclipse-phase.rule.egocast-transfers-are.name: Egocast transfers are subject to light-speed limits

effect.summary: Ego transmissions cannot exceed the light-speed limits of communications.

eclipse-phase.rule.egocast-transfers-are.cost_or_limit: Inner-system trips take minutes; outer-system trips take hours, before endpoint processing.
eclipse-phase.rule.egocast-transfers-are.combines: Endpoint processing and bureaucracy can lengthen a trip.
eclipse-phase.rule.egocast-transfers-are.blocked_reason: This is a timing constraint on communication.

eclipse-phase.rule.spacecraft-reaction-m.name: Spacecraft reaction-mass propulsion

effect.summary: A ship expels heated reaction mass in one direction to accelerate in the opposite direction.

eclipse-phase.rule.spacecraft-reaction-m.cost_or_limit: Fuel is required, and even small movements can be costly.
eclipse-phase.rule.spacecraft-reaction-m.go_wrong: Insufficient reserve fuel can leave a crew in danger after a course deviation.
eclipse-phase.rule.spacecraft-reaction-m.combines: Long trips use acceleration, coasting, then a flipped deceleration burn.
eclipse-phase.rule.spacecraft-reaction-m.blocked_reason: The rule describes ordinary movement driven by expelling mass.

eclipse-phase.rule.planning-a-route-befo.name: Planning a route before departure is required

effect.summary: Spacecraft routes are planned before departure, often using gravity assists or aerobraking.

eclipse-phase.rule.planning-a-route-befo.go_wrong: Unexpected obstacles or attacks can put a ship off course and endanger its crew.
eclipse-phase.rule.planning-a-route-befo.combines: Routes may use slingshots or aerobraking.
eclipse-phase.rule.planning-a-route-befo.blocked_reason: This is a travel-planning and resource constraint.

eclipse-phase.rule.gate-destinations-and.name: Gate destinations and operation are unpredictable

effect.summary: Gates may change destination or cease functioning without warning.

eclipse-phase.rule.gate-destinations-and.cost_or_limit: Destinations cannot be confidently known before opening.
eclipse-phase.rule.gate-destinations-and.go_wrong: A gate may switch off during transit or produce a lethal gravitational event.
eclipse-phase.rule.gate-destinations-and.who_may: Gate users are subject to this rule.
eclipse-phase.rule.gate-destinations-and.blocked_reason: The rule depends on unstable wormhole destinations and transit behavior.

eclipse-phase.rule.centrifugal-habitat-g.name: Centrifugal habitat gravity

effect.summary: Rotation produces an outward force that simulates gravity; faster rotation increases the force, which falls toward zero near the axis.

eclipse-phase.rule.centrifugal-habitat-g.cost_or_limit: Gravity varies with distance from the axis and rotational speed.
eclipse-phase.rule.centrifugal-habitat-g.combines: Momentum wheels and balancing masses support rotation and stability.
eclipse-phase.rule.centrifugal-habitat-g.blocked_reason: This describes a physical environmental mechanism.

eclipse-phase.rule.feedstock-is-required.name: Feedstock is required for nanofabrication

effect.summary: Fabbers need raw materials and cannot create goods from nothing.

eclipse-phase.rule.feedstock-is-required.cost_or_limit: Feedstock is the major material constraint; hazardous or rare elements may require permission and high payment.
eclipse-phase.rule.feedstock-is-required.go_wrong: Without adequate feedstock, fabrication cannot proceed.
eclipse-phase.rule.feedstock-is-required.where_from: Habitat utilities, supplied bricks, recycling, and scavenging.
eclipse-phase.rule.feedstock-is-required.combines: Used by nanofabbers to make blueprint designs.

eclipse-phase.rule.fabrication-time.name: Fabrication time

effect.summary: Larger and more complex prints take longer than simple objects.

eclipse-phase.rule.fabrication-time.cost_or_limit: Typical prints take hours; complex ones may take a day or more.
eclipse-phase.rule.fabrication-time.combines: Fabbers use an ALI to optimize designs and address assembly flaws.
eclipse-phase.rule.fabrication-time.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward time cost.

eclipse-phase.rule.fabber-software-locks.name: Fabber software locks and prohibited goods

effect.summary: Software controls may prevent printing goods on local prohibited lists.

eclipse-phase.rule.fabber-software-locks.cost_or_limit: Rules vary by polity and habitat; devices brought into new habitats may be inspected.
eclipse-phase.rule.fabber-software-locks.go_wrong: Attempts to print restricted goods may be blocked.
eclipse-phase.rule.fabber-software-locks.who_may: Fabber operators are subject to local rules.
eclipse-phase.rule.fabber-software-locks.combines: Authorities may restrict blueprints and feedstock too.
eclipse-phase.rule.fabber-software-locks.blocked_reason: This is a simple restriction on which objects can be made.

eclipse-phase.rule.computational-cluster.name: Computational clusters above a certain power and storage are discouraged or forbidden

effect.summary: Large computational resources are restricted to reduce the perceived risk of runaway seed AIs.

eclipse-phase.rule.computational-cluster.cost_or_limit: The threshold for power and storage is not specified.
eclipse-phase.rule.computational-cluster.go_wrong: A seed AI could run rampant; the passage says prohibitions are often broken.
eclipse-phase.rule.computational-cluster.who_may: Computational facility operators are subject to the restriction.
eclipse-phase.rule.computational-cluster.combines: Some groups use analog technology or disconnect from the mesh.
eclipse-phase.rule.computational-cluster.blocked_reason: The passage gives a broad restriction intended to contain advanced AI, but no operational threshold or procedure.

eclipse-phase.rule.habitat-survival-depe.name: Habitat survival depends on engineering

effect.summary: Habitats rely on thin barriers against vacuum or toxic atmospheres; a failure can cause immediate, possibly irreversible death.

eclipse-phase.rule.habitat-survival-depe.blocked_reason: This is a hazard rule, not an effect requiring unavailable grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.rep-scores-reflect-st.name: Rep scores reflect standing, not a spendable balance

effect.summary: Asking for a favor does not automatically lower reputation; overburdening friends or making dangerous requests can hurt standing.

eclipse-phase.rule.rep-scores-reflect-st.cost_or_limit: Effects depend on community norms and the request.
eclipse-phase.rule.rep-scores-reflect-st.combines: Reputation can help obtain favors, services, and access.
eclipse-phase.rule.rep-scores-reflect-st.blocked_reason: This is a social consequence rule that can be adjudicated without a special effect.

eclipse-phase.rule.social-network-reputa.name: Social network reputation changes through interactions

effect.summary: Interactions raise or lower a network score, with differing weights across networks.

eclipse-phase.rule.social-network-reputa.cost_or_limit: A single rating usually has negligible impact; effects accumulate and vary by network.
eclipse-phase.rule.social-network-reputa.go_wrong: Community standards can make the same action positive in one network and negative in another.
eclipse-phase.rule.social-network-reputa.blocked_reason: Score changes and their consequences fit the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.public-personal-data-.name: Public personal data can enable tracking

effect.summary: A sufficiently resourced adversary can combine public data and device traces to infer a person's location, contacts, and activities.

eclipse-phase.rule.public-personal-data-.cost_or_limit: Requires sufficient access and resources; not all data is available to everyone.
eclipse-phase.rule.public-personal-data-.go_wrong: Personal details can reveal movements and associations.
eclipse-phase.rule.public-personal-data-.who_may: A dedicated adversary with adequate resources.
eclipse-phase.rule.public-personal-data-.where_from: Social networks, devices, metadata, and surveillance systems.
eclipse-phase.rule.public-personal-data-.combines: Coveillance, biometric recognition, and shared data increase exposure.
eclipse-phase.rule.public-personal-data-.blocked_reason: Tracking and information gathering fit the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.secondary-identities-.name: Secondary identities have limited reputation

effect.summary: A fabricated or secondary identity can provide cover but starts with restricted reputation.

eclipse-phase.rule.secondary-identities-.cost_or_limit: Limited rep scores constrain social access.
eclipse-phase.rule.secondary-identities-.who_may: People who establish a secondary identity.
eclipse-phase.rule.secondary-identities-.where_from: Black markets or habitats with lax citizenship procedures.
eclipse-phase.rule.secondary-identities-.combines: Useful for travel and avoiding harassment or prejudice.
eclipse-phase.rule.secondary-identities-.blocked_reason: This is an identity limitation, not an effect requiring special mechanics.

eclipse-phase.rule.social-media-can-shap.name: Social media can shape political attitudes and actions

effect.summary: Targeted propaganda can change attitudes, undermine support, fuel antagonism, and encourage violence.

eclipse-phase.rule.social-media-can-shap.cost_or_limit: Campaigns can target receptive or vulnerable audiences; effects are not guaranteed.
eclipse-phase.rule.social-media-can-shap.go_wrong: Can amplify extremist or bigoted beliefs and provoke violence.
eclipse-phase.rule.social-media-can-shap.where_from: Social media, troll farms, botnets, and targeted advertising.
eclipse-phase.rule.social-media-can-shap.combines: Personalized marketing data and mass amplification increase impact.
eclipse-phase.rule.social-media-can-shap.blocked_reason: The passage describes persuasion and attitude change but does not provide a resolvable mind-control mechanism.

eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-blockade-is-l.name: Earth's blockade is lethal to crossing ships

effect.summary: Ships crossing the 300–350 kilometer altitude band around Earth are targeted by lethal orbital weapons.

eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-blockade-is-l.cost_or_limit: The dangerous band operates in both directions and gives no warning.
eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-blockade-is-l.go_wrong: Killsats, smart mines, and high-velocity debris can destroy ships.
eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-blockade-is-l.who_may: Any ship attempting passage through the band.
eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-blockade-is-l.combines: Cloaked mines and orbital debris add hazards even when weapons are avoided.
eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-blockade-is-l.blocked_reason: A triggered attack on ships crossing a defined boundary fits the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-can-affect-tem.name: Morphs can affect temperament and perception

effect.summary: Hormonal balance and morph design can influence thought, perception, aggression, and instinct.

eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-can-affect-tem.go_wrong: A pacifist in a fury morph could become more inclined to fight.
eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-can-affect-tem.who_may: People sleeved in morphs with relevant traits.
eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-can-affect-tem.combines: Fury morphs combine heightened aggression with enhanced physical capabilities.
eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-can-affect-tem.blocked_reason: The passage ties mental effects to morph embodiment and resleeving, which requires form and body-state mechanics.

eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-as-self-expres.name: Morphs as self-expression

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-as-self-expres.cost_or_limit: Changing morphs can change appearance and the character of relationships.
eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-as-self-expres.combines: Resleeving and sculpting can affect how a person is perceived.
eclipse-phase.rule.morphs-as-self-expres.blocked_reason: The passage describes changing bodies and appearance, beyond the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.morph-reproductive-li.name: Morph reproductive licensing

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.morph-reproductive-li.cost_or_limit: Using a morph’s reproductive capability requires an IP license and gene therapy; anatomy may also need alteration.
eclipse-phase.rule.morph-reproductive-li.who_may: Licensed users who undergo gene therapy
eclipse-phase.rule.morph-reproductive-li.blocked_reason: Gene therapy and reproductive-anatomy changes require bodily modification beyond the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.exowomb-reproduction.name: Exowomb reproduction

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.exowomb-reproduction.cost_or_limit: Gestation is customizable and may use parents’ genetic profiles or licensed profiles; custom traits depend on resources.
eclipse-phase.rule.exowomb-reproduction.combines: Genetic editing, epigenetic guidance, and grafted modifications can shape the child.
eclipse-phase.rule.exowomb-reproduction.blocked_reason: The process creates and edits a developing biological form, which the basic effect grammar cannot model.

eclipse-phase.rule.child-resleeving-rest.name: Child resleeving restrictions

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.child-resleeving-rest.cost_or_limit: Most factions restrict resleeving children below adulthood and regulate suitable morphs and ego ages.
eclipse-phase.rule.child-resleeving-rest.go_wrong: Adult bodies can irreversibly damage a child’s development.
eclipse-phase.rule.child-resleeving-rest.mind: Immature minds may be harmed by adult bodies.
eclipse-phase.rule.child-resleeving-rest.who_may: Children may occupy only legally permitted child or adolescent morphs.
eclipse-phase.rule.child-resleeving-rest.blocked_reason: The rule depends on transferring a consciousness between bodies and age-specific ego states.

eclipse-phase.rule.old-market-access-res.name: Old-market access restrictions

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.old-market-access-res.cost_or_limit: Access to nanofabrication and virtual property is limited to sustain currency-based markets; basic goods may require payment.
eclipse-phase.rule.old-market-access-res.go_wrong: People without currency can lose access to life-supporting products.
eclipse-phase.rule.old-market-access-res.who_may: Access depends on market participation and local restrictions.
eclipse-phase.rule.old-market-access-res.combines: Scarcity and regulated fabrication sustain market incentives.

eclipse-phase.rule.transitional-economy-.name: Transitional-economy fabrication allotments

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.transitional-economy-.cost_or_limit: Subscribers receive restricted fabrication time and feedstock, often for a recurring fee; goods and allotments vary by habitat.
eclipse-phase.rule.transitional-economy-.go_wrong: Nonpayment may cut off basic goods and cause biological or synthetic processes to fail.
eclipse-phase.rule.transitional-economy-.combines: Some basic commodities are public services; restricted goods remain for sale.
eclipse-phase.rule.transitional-economy-.mechanism: Subscriber fabber quotas and feedstock limits

eclipse-phase.rule.consortium-fabber-res.name: Consortium fabber restrictions

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.consortium-fabber-res.cost_or_limit: Allowances cover basic goods; electronics, smart goods, biological commodities, and weapons are restricted.
eclipse-phase.rule.consortium-fabber-res.combines: Access requires allotted fabrication time and feedstock.

eclipse-phase.rule.morningstar-fabricati.name: Morningstar fabrication restrictions

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.morningstar-fabricati.cost_or_limit: Nanofabrication is restricted mainly for radioactive or nuclear devices, biohazards, weapons, and goods unsuitable for desktop fabrication.
eclipse-phase.rule.morningstar-fabricati.who_may: Residents with access to local fabrication
eclipse-phase.rule.morningstar-fabricati.combines: Goods may otherwise be acquired without payment.

eclipse-phase.rule.intellectual-property.name: Intellectual-property fabrication controls

effect.summary: none stated

eclipse-phase.rule.intellectual-property.cost_or_limit: Some polities require payment for blueprints and creator approval for modifications; protection varies by habitat.
eclipse-phase.rule.intellectual-property.go_wrong: Unlicensed copying can undermine owners’ revenue and may be policed.
eclipse-phase.rule.intellectual-property.who_may: Blueprint purchasers, subject to local rules
eclipse-phase.rule.intellectual-property.where_from: Consortium and LLA protections; weaker protections elsewhere
eclipse-phase.rule.intellectual-property.combines: Digital rights management and enforcement can protect virtual assets.
eclipse-phase.rule.intellectual-property.mechanism: Licensed blueprint access and modification control

eclipse-phase.rule.indenture-service-ext.name: Indenture service extensions

effect.summary: Infugees pay for optional services by extending their period of service, and may spend accumulated credit on restorative services that extend contracts.

eclipse-phase.rule.indenture-service-ext.cost_or_limit: Service duration may be extended by the cost of services.
eclipse-phase.rule.indenture-service-ext.who_may: Applies to infugees contracted by hypercorporations.
eclipse-phase.rule.indenture-service-ext.combines: Optional entertainment, education, care, personal time, and communication services may be priced into service.
eclipse-phase.rule.indenture-service-ext.blocked_reason: A service-duration cost can be tracked as a contract or resource limit.

eclipse-phase.rule.autonomist-resource-a.name: Autonomist resource approval

effect.summary: Rare elements may need local approval, and isolated communities can collectively limit scarce resources.

eclipse-phase.rule.autonomist-resource-a.cost_or_limit: Access to scarce materials can be restricted by community decision.
eclipse-phase.rule.autonomist-resource-a.go_wrong: Unapproved resource-intensive projects may be socially condemned or denied support.
eclipse-phase.rule.autonomist-resource-a.combines: Large projects may require social capital and collective action.
eclipse-phase.rule.autonomist-resource-a.blocked_reason: Approval and scarcity limits can be handled as ordinary access constraints.

eclipse-phase.rule.return-of-public-reso.name: Return of public resources

effect.summary: Visitors may use shared public resources with the expectation they return them when no longer needed.

eclipse-phase.rule.return-of-public-reso.cost_or_limit: Access may be monitored or limited based on reputation, faction, or exile status; basic needs remain available.
eclipse-phase.rule.return-of-public-reso.go_wrong: Failure to return or misuse may affect access and standing.
eclipse-phase.rule.return-of-public-reso.who_may: Visitors and community members, subject to local access decisions.
eclipse-phase.rule.return-of-public-reso.combines: Morph availability and quality can depend on scarcity, reputation, local needs, and body-bank cooperative decisions.
eclipse-phase.rule.return-of-public-reso.blocked_reason: The rule concerns access and return of things, which the basic ledger can track.

eclipse-phase.rule.personal-possessions-.name: Personal possessions and communal property

effect.summary: Portable items accumulated for immediate personal use remain personal; other resources are communal, borrowed and returned, with scarce use based on need.

eclipse-phase.rule.personal-possessions-.cost_or_limit: Hoarding and materialism are socially condemned; use of scarce goods follows greatest need.
eclipse-phase.rule.personal-possessions-.go_wrong: Overuse of rare resources or failure to contribute can reduce reputation.
eclipse-phase.rule.personal-possessions-.combines: Access methods vary among votes, AI or board review, decentralized processes, and queues.
eclipse-phase.rule.personal-possessions-.blocked_reason: Personal ownership and communal access can be represented as relation and access rules.

eclipse-phase.rule.community-service-con.name: Community service contribution

effect.summary: Habitat residents are expected to contribute maintenance time as a condition of community membership.

eclipse-phase.rule.community-service-con.cost_or_limit: Time requirements vary from a few hours monthly to several days weekly.
eclipse-phase.rule.community-service-con.combines: Duties include care, maintenance, gardening, militia work, and other habitat needs.
eclipse-phase.rule.community-service-con.blocked_reason: Time costs and reputation changes can be tracked directly.

eclipse-phase.rule.reputation-effects.name: Reputation effects

effect.summary: Recognized contributions can raise reputation, while antisocial behavior or rule-breaking can lower it; scores can be distorted and change over time.

eclipse-phase.rule.reputation-effects.cost_or_limit: Reputation is not bought or sold and depends on community recognition.
eclipse-phase.rule.reputation-effects.go_wrong: Cliques, sock puppets, viral attention, privacy, and bad luck can distort scores.
eclipse-phase.rule.reputation-effects.who_may: Community members judge contributions and behavior.
eclipse-phase.rule.reputation-effects.combines: Scores can help secure favors, support, and communal access.
eclipse-phase.rule.reputation-effects.blocked_reason: Reputation changes and access consequences can be represented as relation and information changes.

eclipse-phase.rule.property-rights-witho.name: Property rights without sovereignty

effect.summary: A celestial resource claim lasts only while its claimant continues using it; an abandoned claim may be taken by someone else.

eclipse-phase.rule.property-rights-witho.cost_or_limit: Continued use is required to maintain the claim.
eclipse-phase.rule.property-rights-witho.go_wrong: Disputes may be resolved through deception or violence as well as negotiation or legal proceedings.
eclipse-phase.rule.property-rights-witho.who_may: Discoverers and subsequent users of celestial resources.
eclipse-phase.rule.property-rights-witho.where_from: Claims on asteroids, exoplanets, and other celestial bodies.
eclipse-phase.rule.property-rights-witho.combines: Shared-polity parties may use negotiation or legal proceedings.
eclipse-phase.rule.property-rights-witho.blocked_reason: The rule is a use-based ownership condition.

eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-access-t.name: Pandora gate access terms

effect.summary: Gate owners set access terms; users may offset expensive leases by granting a stake in discoveries, resources, or colony revenue.

eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-access-t.cost_or_limit: Gate leasing is very expensive and may require shared ownership or revenue.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-access-t.who_may: Gate owners dictate terms to users.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-access-t.combines: Expeditions may be sponsored by organizations that receive rights to finds.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-access-t.blocked_reason: The rule concerns access costs and contractual shares.

eclipse-phase.rule.expedition-ownership-.name: Expedition ownership contracts

effect.summary: Gatecrashers commonly sign away ownership of discoveries to their sponsor, though some contracts return a percentage share.

eclipse-phase.rule.expedition-ownership-.cost_or_limit: Claims may be fully assigned or shared by contract.
eclipse-phase.rule.expedition-ownership-.combines: May include gate-time leases and discovery or colony revenue shares.
eclipse-phase.rule.expedition-ownership-.blocked_reason: Ownership shares can be tracked as contract relations.

eclipse-phase.rule.crime-varies-by-socie.name: Crime varies by society

effect.summary: Each habitat and society defines its own crimes and penalties.

eclipse-phase.rule.crime-varies-by-socie.blocked_reason: This is a local-law rule that can be applied directly.

eclipse-phase.rule.murder-and-backups.name: Murder and backups

effect.summary: A backed-up victim may be restored after murder by resleeving.

eclipse-phase.rule.murder-and-backups.cost_or_limit: Restoration depends on a usable backup and resleeving being possible.
eclipse-phase.rule.murder-and-backups.go_wrong: If everyone is killed or the habitat is ruined, resleeving may be impossible.
eclipse-phase.rule.murder-and-backups.blocked_reason: The passage depends on persistence and restoration of an ego after death, which the basic effect grammar cannot model.

eclipse-phase.rule.habitat-attack-and-ex.name: Habitat attack and execution

effect.summary: Defenders may execute an attacker treated as an enemy combatant.

eclipse-phase.rule.habitat-attack-and-ex.cost_or_limit: Applies when an attack crosses from crime into military action.
eclipse-phase.rule.habitat-attack-and-ex.blocked_reason: This is a rule for classifying and responding to an attack.

eclipse-phase.rule.limited-availability-.name: Limited availability raises theft penalties

effect.summary: Stealing scarce goods is penalized more strictly than taking readily replicated items.

eclipse-phase.rule.limited-availability-.blocked_reason: This is a legal consequence based on an item's availability.

eclipse-phase.rule.life-support-allotmen.name: Life-support allotment

effect.summary: Life-support resources are allotted, and systems can sustain only a limited population.

eclipse-phase.rule.life-support-allotmen.cost_or_limit: Visitors may owe an allotment for breathing; crowded habitats have finite capacity.
eclipse-phase.rule.life-support-allotmen.go_wrong: Squatting can strain life support or expose occupants to hazards in derelicts.
eclipse-phase.rule.life-support-allotmen.blocked_reason: The resource cost and capacity limit can be represented as a game constraint.

eclipse-phase.rule.copyright-and-drm-res.name: Copyright and DRM restrictions

effect.summary: Some polities prohibit sharing protected designs or bypassing file and fabrication restrictions.

eclipse-phase.rule.copyright-and-drm-res.cost_or_limit: Rules vary by polity and may carry heavy penalties.
eclipse-phase.rule.copyright-and-drm-res.who_may: Authorities in the inner system and Jovian Republic
eclipse-phase.rule.copyright-and-drm-res.combines: DRM, nanofab locks, copyright, and trade secrets
eclipse-phase.rule.copyright-and-drm-res.blocked_reason: This is a legal restriction on information and fabrication access.

eclipse-phase.rule.fork-expirations.name: Fork expirations

effect.summary: Some forks are legally required to stop operating when their permitted term expires.

eclipse-phase.rule.fork-expirations.cost_or_limit: The legal expiration limits how long a fork may continue.
eclipse-phase.rule.fork-expirations.go_wrong: Forks may go rogue or overrun their permitted term.
eclipse-phase.rule.fork-expirations.blocked_reason: Forks are continuing copies of minds, a state the basic effect grammar cannot represent.

eclipse-phase.rule.exsurgent-linked-drug.name: Exsurgent-linked drugs are banned

effect.summary: Polities ban drugs associated with exsurgent infection.

eclipse-phase.rule.exsurgent-linked-drug.cost_or_limit: Ban applies to drugs linked to infection.
eclipse-phase.rule.exsurgent-linked-drug.blocked_reason: This is a prohibition on a category of goods.

eclipse-phase.rule.pornography-restricti.name: Pornography restrictions

effect.summary: Some habitats prohibit pornography depicting locally defined illegal acts or coercion.

eclipse-phase.rule.pornography-restricti.cost_or_limit: Restrictions vary with local ideology; examples include uplift or indenture depictions.
eclipse-phase.rule.pornography-restricti.blocked_reason: This is a locally defined legal restriction.

eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-on.name: Indentured service on Titan

effect.summary: Indentured service is illegal on Titan; many outer-system anarchists treat indentures as enslaved people entitled to freedom.

eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-on.cost_or_limit: Legality and treatment vary by polity.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-on.go_wrong: Coercion may make service unlawful or prompt liberation.
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-on.mechanism: legal status and freedom from coercion
eclipse-phase.rule.indentured-service-on.blocked_reason: The passage states a legal rule about indentured service.

eclipse-phase.rule.anarchist-common-owne.name: Anarchist common ownership

effect.summary: Anarchist communities hold community resources in common, with personal possessions as the exception.

eclipse-phase.rule.anarchist-common-owne.cost_or_limit: Applies to community-owned resources and fabricated goods.
eclipse-phase.rule.anarchist-common-owne.go_wrong: Mooching or misuse of shared resources can damage a community.
eclipse-phase.rule.anarchist-common-owne.blocked_reason: This is a property and ownership rule.

eclipse-phase.rule.extropian-contract-ru.name: Extropian contract rule

effect.summary: Written contracts are the binding law for habitat services and ongoing economic relationships.

eclipse-phase.rule.extropian-contract-ru.cost_or_limit: Contracts must be agreed by involved parties and are backed by freelance judiciaries.
eclipse-phase.rule.extropian-contract-ru.blocked_reason: This is a binding legal relation.

eclipse-phase.rule.extropian-non-aggress.name: Extropian non-aggression policy

effect.summary: Threatening or using violence against another person violates their right to self-determination.

eclipse-phase.rule.extropian-non-aggress.blocked_reason: This is a behavioral and legal restriction.

eclipse-phase.rule.jovian-restrictions-o.name: Jovian restrictions on AGIs and uplifts

effect.summary: AGIs and uplifts are forbidden in the Jovian Republic.

eclipse-phase.rule.jovian-restrictions-o.combines: Part of its bioconservative security policy.

eclipse-phase.rule.jovian-slingshot-taxa.name: Jovian slingshot taxation

effect.summary: Ships using Jupiter’s gravity well to save fuel are automatically assessed a tax.

eclipse-phase.rule.jovian-slingshot-taxa.cost_or_limit: Applies to ships taking advantage of the gravity well.

eclipse-phase.rule.scum-gift-exchange.name: Scum gift exchange

effect.summary: Scum and autonomists commonly exchange gifts and rely on reputation rather than currency or contracts.

eclipse-phase.rule.scum-gift-exchange.cost_or_limit: Primarily applies among scum and autonomists.
eclipse-phase.rule.scum-gift-exchange.combines: Other economies may require currency or contracts.

effect.summary: Commonwealth kroner are reinvested in microcorps rather than spent.

eclipse-phase.rule.titanian-social-contr.name: Titanian social contract

effect.summary: Coming-of-age citizens enter an agreement specifying voting and initiative rights.

eclipse-phase.rule.titanian-social-contr.cost_or_limit: Applies when a citizen comes of age.

eclipse-phase.rule.forking-is-permitted.name: Forking is permitted

effect.summary: The Commonwealth permits forks.

eclipse-phase.rule.forking-is-permitted.mind: Creates a copy of a mind.
eclipse-phase.rule.forking-is-permitted.blocked_reason: The passage permits forks but does not specify their identity, continuity, or other soul-state consequences.

eclipse-phase.rule.firewall-compartmenta.name: Firewall compartmentalization

effect.summary: No single cell or server has an organization-wide view; control would require 50.1% of members.

eclipse-phase.rule.firewall-compartmenta.cost_or_limit: An adversary would need control of more than half the membership to control Firewall.
eclipse-phase.rule.firewall-compartmenta.go_wrong: A serious breach could still threaten the organization.
eclipse-phase.rule.firewall-compartmenta.who_may: Applies to Firewall cells and servers.

effect.summary: Proxies generally rotate roles or servers yearly to prevent concentration of power and single points of failure.

eclipse-phase.rule.firewall-proposal-thr.name: Firewall proposal threshold

effect.summary: A proxy’s proposal needs support from 500 other proxies to proceed to a vote.

eclipse-phase.rule.firewall-proposal-thr.combines: Votes are reserved for major policy or operational decisions.

effect.summary: Regular proxy rotation among servers helps prevent powerful faction blocs.

eclipse-phase.rule.a-coronal-mass-ejecti.name: A coronal mass ejection can disrupt communications and sensors

effect.summary: Solar plasma can harm exposed craft and life and trigger storms on planets without protective magnetic fields.

eclipse-phase.rule.a-coronal-mass-ejecti.go_wrong: The ejection can cause widespread damage.
eclipse-phase.rule.a-coronal-mass-ejecti.combines: A strong magnetic force might redirect one as a weapon.

eclipse-phase.rule.lowland-venus-operati.name: Lowland Venus operations require specialized bodies

effect.summary: Below seven kilometers, permanent facilities use synthmorphs and infomorphs, often with remote operation.

eclipse-phase.rule.lowland-venus-operati.cost_or_limit: Biological settlers are largely restricted to high mountain low-pressure zones.
eclipse-phase.rule.lowland-venus-operati.go_wrong: Extreme environmental conditions destroy equipment and endanger occupants.

eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-fence-attacks.name: Earth's Fence attacks traffic entering or leaving the kill zone

effect.summary: The blockade monitors traffic and uses weapons against detected entrants and departures.

eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-fence-attacks.cost_or_limit: The kill zone is roughly 300–350 kilometers in altitude.
eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-fence-attacks.combines: Satellites, jammers, mines, and drones support the blockade.
eclipse-phase.rule.earth-s-fence-attacks.blocked_reason: The rule describes a persistent, multi-system attack field over a region.

eclipse-phase.rule.jovian-radiation-expo.name: Jovian radiation exposure

effect.summary: Unshielded exposure in intense Jovian radiation can be lethal within hours or minutes.

eclipse-phase.rule.jovian-radiation-expo.cost_or_limit: Risk increases nearer Jupiter and depends on shielding.

effect.summary: Citizenship is open to anyone who serves in Hyoden’s military.

eclipse-phase.rule.itn-cycler-fuel-endur.name: ITN Cycler fuel endurance

effect.summary: Self-sufficient ITN Cyclers carry enough fuel for at least a thousand years before needing a top-up.

eclipse-phase.rule.itn-cycler-fuel-endur.cost_or_limit: The usual stated minimum is a thousand years of fuel.
eclipse-phase.rule.itn-cycler-fuel-endur.who_may: Applies to most self-sufficient ITN Cyclers.
eclipse-phase.rule.itn-cycler-fuel-endur.combines: The route uses gravity assists, quick burns, and occasional aerobraking.
eclipse-phase.rule.itn-cycler-fuel-endur.blocked_reason: This is a world-mechanism rule, not an effect requiring an unsupported capability.

eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-travel.name: Pandora gate travel

effect.summary: Gates connect distant locations across the galaxy through wormholes.

eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-travel.cost_or_limit: Destinations can be programmed, but the process is not fully refined.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-travel.go_wrong: Gate procedures and access rules vary by operator.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-travel.who_may: Travelers authorized by the gate’s managing group.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-travel.combines: Each gate has a different managing organization and local procedures.
eclipse-phase.rule.pandora-gate-travel.blocked_reason: The stated wormhole movement is representable by the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.beam-weapon-batteries.name: Beam weapon batteries

effect.summary: Beam weapons use a standard battery for shots; a nuclear battery fully recharges it in four hours, and batteries cannot be shared across beam weapon types.

eclipse-phase.rule.beam-weapon-batteries.cost_or_limit: A standard battery holds the listed ammunition capacity.
eclipse-phase.rule.beam-weapon-batteries.combines: Battery type is limited to its weapon type.
eclipse-phase.rule.beam-weapon-batteries.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not model battery capacity and recharge.

eclipse-phase.rule.freezer-foam-degradat.name: Freezer foam degradation

effect.summary: Hardened freezer foam slowly degrades over twelve hours.

eclipse-phase.rule.freezer-foam-degradat.cost_or_limit: The foam's useful duration is about twelve hours.
eclipse-phase.rule.freezer-foam-degradat.go_wrong: Foam degrades and loses its function.
eclipse-phase.rule.freezer-foam-degradat.combines: Foam can entrap targets or form temporary cover.
eclipse-phase.rule.freezer-foam-degradat.blocked_reason: A lasting effect with a duration can be tracked by the basic effect grammar.

eclipse-phase.rule.railgun-ammunition-re.name: Railgun ammunition restriction

effect.summary: Railguns require conductive projectiles that tolerate acceleration and heat; they cannot use smart or specialty ammunition, and their ammunition cannot be exchanged with firearms.

eclipse-phase.rule.railgun-ammunition-re.combines: Railgun ammunition can be shared among railguns of the same class.
eclipse-phase.rule.railgun-ammunition-re.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not model ammunition compatibility rules.

eclipse-phase.rule.smart-ammunition-prog.name: Smart ammunition programming

effect.summary: Firearm smart bullets may be reprogrammed with a complex action, but bullets fired together must all use the same selected form.

eclipse-phase.rule.smart-ammunition-prog.combines: Smart bullets can take accushot, hollow-point, or plastic forms.
eclipse-phase.rule.smart-ammunition-prog.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not model ammunition configuration and volley restrictions.

eclipse-phase.rule.seeker-and-grenade-tr.name: Seeker and grenade trigger options

effect.summary: Munitions can be set to airburst, impact, proximity, signal, or timer triggers; missed or non-detonating shots may scatter.

eclipse-phase.rule.seeker-and-grenade-tr.cost_or_limit: Airburst has a minimum safety distance; proximity activation takes three turns; timers range from one second to years.
